WAREHOUSE OPERATIVE - PART TIME

Location: Doncaster
Hours: Part-time, 20 hours a week, shifts between 6am and 2pm
Rate: £12.50 an hour

On site role in a busy distribution centre picking and packing orders for high street retailers.

REQUIREMENTS
* Able to lift 15kg repeatedly
* Reliable and punctual
* Previous warehouse experience is a plus
* Forklift licence is desirable

Apply with your CV. No agencies please.
